reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, and 200 mg bisglycinate with no oxide, which is what I look for on a label. I would try one box, but only after scanning the QR and finding a real report.
objection: A brand with zero reviews, and I do not know how big the capsules are. I have left bad reviews on huge ones, and two capsules a night at that fill weight could be a problem.
would_change_my_mind: A capsule size or dimensions in the listing, plus a few real reviews that say they are easy to swallow.
